case_information.customer_feedback_summary: The reviews consistently praise the hotel's central location, helpful and attentive staff, comfortable, clean rooms and beds, and easy access to parking and local attractions; breakfast is frequently described as plentiful and varied though a couple of guests found it unremarkable. Positive mentions include a rooftop bar and strong welcome, while isolated negatives note slow check-in and absence of an on-site café/restaurant.
